title: 第20章 先秦炼气士？阵法？
novel_title: 先秦炼气两千年，世人误闯天家
content_zh:
“阵法？”

    “先秦炼气士？”

    物理学家陈振博士立刻皱起了眉头，“金老，我们是科学节目，请不要用这些无法验证的词汇。在我看来，这不过是一些装饰性的花纹，或许是某种失传的古代艺术风格。”

    金世昌看了他一眼，摇了摇头，没有争辩，只是用近乎梦呓的声音说道：“你不懂……你不懂啊……这种符文，只在最古老的典籍，甚至是神话传说中才有过零星的记载。它代表的，是‘规则’，是‘道’……凡人触之，必有大祸！”

    他的话，让直播间的气氛瞬间变得有些诡异。

    【禁断大阵？听着就好牛逼的样子！金大师有料啊！】

    【得了吧，都什么年代了还阵法，我看就是个故弄玄虚的老骗子。】

    【我站陈博士，相信科学！这门肯定有科学的解释！】

    【可是……你们不觉得这花纹看着就让人心里发毛吗？我一个无神论者都感觉瘆得慌。】

    就在直播间里吵得不可开交的时候，现场的林薇已经走到了巨门之前。

    她伸出手，戴着特制手套，轻轻地触摸了一下那冰冷的门体。

    “触感坚硬，冰冷，表面极其光滑，没有丝毫的锈蚀痕迹。”

    她冷静地汇报着情况，“陈博士，准备进行材质分析。”

    “收到。”

    一名队员立刻上前，从身后的装备包里取出了一个手持式的光谱分析仪，对准了青铜门。

    “滴滴滴……”

    仪器发出了急促的蜂鸣声，屏幕上，一连串复杂的数据疯狂地跳动起来。

    “怎么回事？”

    林薇问道。

    那名队员的额头上渗出了冷汗，声音都有些变调了：“队……队长，仪器……仪器分析不出来！数据库里，没有任何已知金属或合金能与它的元素构成相匹配！”

    “什么？”

    这个结果，让所有人都大吃一惊。

    演播厅里，陈振博士更是猛地站了起来，一把抢过旁边工作人员递来的同步数据平板，死死地盯着上面的信息。

    “不可能……这绝对不可能！”

    他的呼吸变得急促起来，“这种原子结构，这种密度和硬度……它……它根本就不应该存在于地球上！”

    屏幕上，同步显示出了检测数据。

    硬度：远超目前人类已知的最强合金——钨钢。

    熔点：预估超过一万摄氏度。
content_en:
"Array?"

    "Pre-Qin Qi Refiner?"

    Physicist Dr. Chen Zhen immediately frowned, "Mr. Jin, we are a science program, please don't use these unverifiable words. In my opinion, these are just some decorative patterns, perhaps some kind of lost ancient art style."

    Jin Shichang glanced at him, shook his head, did not argue, and just said in a voice that was almost murmuring: "You don't understand... you don't understand... This kind of rune has only been recorded sparsely in the oldest classics, and even in myths and legends. It represents the 'rules' and the 'Tao'... If a mortal touches it, there will be great disaster!"

    His words made the atmosphere in the live broadcast room instantly become a little weird.

    [Forbidden Formation? It sounds awesome! Master Jin has something! 】

    [Come on, what age are you still using formations? I think you are just an old liar who is trying to be mysterious. 】

    [I stand with Dr. Chen and believe in science! There must be a scientific explanation for this! 】

    [But...don't you think this pattern makes people feel bad just looking at it? As an atheist, I feel terrified. 】

    Just as the live broadcast room was getting noisy, Lin Wei at the scene had already walked to the giant door.

    She stretched out her hand, wearing special gloves, and gently touched the cold door.

    "It feels hard and cold to the touch, and the surface is extremely smooth without any trace of rust."

    She reported the situation calmly, "Dr. Chen, prepare to conduct material analysis."

    "Roger that."

    A team member immediately stepped forward, took out a handheld spectrum analyzer from the equipment bag behind him, and pointed it at the bronze door.

    "Didi didi..."

    The instrument beeped rapidly, and a series of complex data jumped crazily on the screen.

    "What's going on?"

    Lin Wei asked.

    Cold sweat broke out on the forehead of the team member, and his voice changed slightly: "Team... Captain, the instrument... the instrument cannot analyze it! There is no known metal or alloy in the database that can match its elemental composition!"

    "What?"

    This result surprised everyone.

    In the studio, Dr. Chen Zhen stood up suddenly, grabbed the synchronization data tablet handed by the staff next to him, and stared at the information on it.

    "Impossible...This is absolutely impossible!"

    His breathing became rapid, "This atomic structure, this density and hardness... it... it shouldn't exist on the earth at all!"

    On the screen, the detection data is displayed simultaneously.

    Hardness: Far superior to tungsten steel, the strongest alloy currently known to mankind.

    Melting point: estimated to be over 10,000 degrees Celsius.
